preconditions.description: The number of railway stations n must be between 2 and 5000.
The number of railway sections must be exactly n-1.
The number of passengers m must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, g in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must specify valid station indices a and b, and a must not equal b.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= g <= 10**6 for a, b, g in queries)
preconditions.description: The minimum scenery beauty g for each query must be between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output must either be -1 indicating no valid solution or a list of n-1 integers representing the scenery beauty values.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(f) <= 10**6 for f in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: If valid scenery beauty values are output, each value must be between 1 and 10^6.
For each query, the minimum scenery beauty g must be less than or equal to the minimum scenery beauty along the path from a to b.
postconditions.expression: all(g <= min_path_value(a, b) for a, b, g in queries)
